name: storege-wms
description: Storege WMS - نظام إدارة مخازن احترافي بالباركود وأجهزة الكف

scripts.setup: npm install && node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run start -w server
scripts.vercel-build: node scripts/use-postgres.mjs --no-env && prisma generate --schema server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build -w web
scripts.android:sync: npm run build -w web && npx cap sync android
